**Preserve headings that are already below level three.**

If a digest value contains `#### Modules`, `_demote` changes it to `####### Modules`. Markdown does not render seven hashes as a heading, so the export loses the value’s heading structure. Leave level-four through level-six headings unchanged. Demote only level-one through level-three headings.

**Return `USAGE` for a lone surrogate in JSON text.**

`messages.parse_payload` accepts escaped lone surrogates. The report validators then call UTF-8 encoding while calculating the canonical size, which raises `UnicodeEncodeError` instead of the documented `USAGE` refusal. Reject strings that cannot be UTF-8 encoded before canonicalization.

**Remove the ambiguous whitespace paths from the Markdown prefix regex.**

`_PREFIX` can backtrack exponentially when a long quote chain does not lead to a heading or fence. `_value_lines` applies `_FENCE_RE` to every digest-value line, so a sufficiently long digest value can make `export-summary` spend excessive CPU time.

**🔒 Security & Privacy** | **🟡 Minor** | **⚡ Quick win**

**Redact the node token before the nonce scrub, or a wrapped nonce leaks part of itself.**

`scrub` calls `redact(text)` first and `nonce_re` second. Take an echo of the prompt that wraps inside the nonce, such as `node:N1.1.<10 hex>\n  <22 hex>`. `_NODE_TOKEN_RE` matches the prefix and the first 10 hex characters, and replaces them with `<redacted>`. The remaining 22 hex characters stay in the text. `nonce_re` now needs the full nonce, so it cannot match. The 22 characters go into `result.detail`, `out["detail"]`, and the `tool_calls` row.

This is the `r"\1\2\n  "` case in `test_a_wrapped_node_token_is_redacted_by_its_nonce`. The test passes because it asserts only that the full `nonce` is absent. It does not check for partial leaks.

Run `nonce_re` first. It then removes the whole wrapped nonce. After that, `redact` still handles whole tokens and review tokens.

<details>
<summary>🔒️ Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
         def scrub(text: str) -> str:
-            return nonce_re.sub("<redacted>", redact(text))
+            return redact(nonce_re.sub("<redacted>", text))
```

Also tighten the assertion in `tests/qs/control_plane/test_tools.py` (Lines 2109-2110). Use the same 8-character window check as `test_a_node_token_is_redacted_before_the_cut`:

```diff
         for blob in (row["result"], json.dumps(out)):
-            assert nonce not in blob and "<redacted>" in blob
+            assert "<redacted>" in blob
+            assert not any(nonce[i : i + 8] in blob for i in range(len(nonce) - 7))
```
</details>
